persons.name: Mādhavarāva Sāvājī Vijhe
persons.evidence: hastākṣara mādhavarāva sāvā jī vijheṃ pustaka khāsagata

purpose: khāsagata (personal copy), dedicated to Śrī Rāma (śrīrāmārpaṇamastu)
notes: The scribe and owner is identified in Marathi idiom (hastākṣara ... pustaka khāsagata). 'Vijhe' is likely the family name (kulnām), and 'Sāvājī' either patronymic or second name. Nandikeśvara is a dialogue interlocutor in the Rudrayāmala framing and is therefore excluded.
